verification_scope: Source review of the public announcement and published method; the new 26-31D configurations were not independently replayed.
published_logic: Work with discrete pairwise inner products and feasible Gram matrices.
Alternate a filler that extends a configuration with a corrector that removes obstructing rows and columns.
Preserve structural diversity using algebraic invariants and recycle discovered subconfigurations.
october_announcement: Joint optimization of point removals, midpoint insertions and auxiliary layers within Leech-based constructions. The announcement does not specify a complete implementation of that new scheme.
adaptation: Use the fixed rank-48 lattice realization to satisfy Gram feasibility automatically; search the exact |inner product|=3 conflict graph by filling, one-for-two replacements and neutral swaps. Then jointly choose class images by marginal coverage and restore lines previously removed only because an unselected class owned them.
implementation_scope: CPU combinatorial adaptation of the published principle. No reproduction or training of PackingStar reinforcement-learning models is claimed.
priority_scope: The new high-dimensional gains compare with the preceding repository certificate; this review is not a comprehensive new global literature survey.
